blocks.text: Notepad aur Microsoft Word jaisi applications undo ke liye stack istemal karti hain. Har amal, jaise likhna ya mitana, stack par push hota hai. Undo dabane se sab se taaza amal pop ho kar ulat jata hai; dobara dabane se us se pehle wala. Agar aap ne 'Hello' phir 'World' likha to undo pehle 'World' phir 'Hello' hatata hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class Stack:
....def __init__(self):
........self.items = []
....def push(self, item):
........self.items.append(item)
....def pop(self):
........return self.items.pop()
....def peek(self):
........return self.items[-1]

plates = Stack()
for plate in ["Plate 1", "Plate 2", "Plate 3"]:
....plates.push(plate)
....print(plates.items)
print("Removed:", plates.pop(), "Stack:", plates.items)
print("Top plate:", plates.peek())    # Plate 2

blocks.prompt: Class activity: restaurant kitchen ki plates ke liye push, pop aur peek wali Stack class likhein; Plate 1, 2, 3 push, ek pop, phir peek. Aakhir mein kya print hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Oopar ka code (kitab se nahi) stack ko Plate 1, Plate 2, Plate 3 tak barhta dikhata hai; pop Plate 3 hatata, Plate 1, Plate 2 bachti hain; peek Plate 2 dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Stacks ke do asal duniya ke istemal aur un mein amal kaise chalte hain, bataiye (long question 3).
blocks.explanation: Text editor ka undo: har tabdeeli push hoti hai; undo taaza tareen pop kar ke ulat deta hai, to tabdeeliyan naye se purane ki tarteeb mein wapas hoti hain. Browser ka Back button: har dekha page push hota hai; Back maujooda page pop kar ke neeche wala dikhata hai. Plates ka dher bhi aisa hi hai: nayi plate oopar aur oopar wali pehle uthti hai.

items: Undo: amal push, undo taaza tareen pop karta hai; Stack class ko push, pop aur peek chahiyein.
